newsitem.title: USA: AFTER THE BELL - Little movement in share prices.
newsitem.headline: AFTER THE BELL - Little movement in share prices.

text.p: After-hours trading was relatively quiet with no issues making sharp price swings, traders said.
The New York Stock Exchange reported session one volume of 13,600 shares against 7,900 yesterday. In Session II, the exchange totaled 776,472 shares, compared with 7,255,363 shares yesterday.
The American Stock Exchange reported no after hours volume.
